name: bums.level.w3-04.name
authorNotes: Solo. World 3's pop cannon, introduced as the level's Twist: a sticky note by the barrel insists 'TWO PLAYERS REQUIRED — ONE HOLDS, ONE FLIES', and for a party of two or more that is exactly true (see 07). Here, alone, it is a lie a solo player can disprove: cannon-solo's barrel is a grabbable body, and because a fully extended arm reaches 118px from the head centre, a lone player can grip the barrel's rim with one hand while their own head rests in its mouth — then use-item fires themselves, no second player required. That is the twist: the note is honest about the two-player *routine*, not about the physical limit. Players who'd rather not fold themselves into a cannon barrel have a full alternative: trapeze-manual (pivot 680,520, a long 380px bar hanging flush with the starting pier's edge, same convention as every World 1 tutorial swing) crosses the same ~750px gap the slow way, with a pump or two. pose-w3-04 sits on the middle pier — a strongman flex, tolerance 45 — for the pose objective; the checkpoint sits right there too, so a mistimed cannon shot or an over-pumped trapeze only costs the first gap. The second gap closes on familiar ground: trapeze-final2 (pivot 2050,610, moderate 0.2 damping), no cannon involved. Both gaps carry an assist beam for players who want a third, calmer option.
